title: Gitar, a startup that uses agents to secure code, emerges from stealth with $9 million
description: The company uses AI to review code that, more often than not these days, has also been generated by AI.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Anthropic’s rise is giving some OpenAI investors second thoughts
description: One investor who has backed both companies told the FT that justifying OpenAI's recent round required assuming an IPO valuation of $1.2 trillion or more — making Anthropic's current $380 billion valuation look like the relative bargain.
author: Connie Loizos

title: Anthropic co-founder confirms the company briefed the Trump administration on Mythos
description: In an interview at the Semafor World Economy summit this week, Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark explained why the company was still engaged with the U.S. government while simultaneously suing them.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Max Hodak’s Science Corp. is preparing to place its first sensor in a human brain
description: The device could help address multiple neurological conditions if it proves successful. One early use could be delivering gentle electrical stimulation to damaged brain or spinal cord cells to encourage healing.
author: Tim Fernholz

title: Google adds AI Skills to Chrome to help you save favorite workflows
description: Google is adding “Skills” to Chrome, letting users save and reuse AI prompts across websites. The feature builds on Gemini’s browser integration.
author: Sarah Perez

title: In just a couple weeks, StrictlyVC San Francisco brings leaders from TDK Ventures, Replit, and more together
description:
The first StrictlyVC of the year will be coming to San Francisco before you know it.

There are still a few tickets available to join us and our stacked speaker lineup April 30, so register today!
author: TechCrunch Events

title: Google brings its Gemini Personal Intelligence feature to India
description: The feature lets users connect Google accounts like Gmail and Photos to get personalized answers
author: Ivan Mehta

title: How vibe coding app Anything is rebuilding after getting booted from the App Store twice
description: Anything is planning to launch a desktop companion app to aid mobile app development after its App Store removal.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: OpenAI has bought AI personal finance startup Hiro
description: The acquisition indicates a capability that OpenAI is building into ChatGPT: financial planning.
author: Julie Bort

title: Microsoft is working on yet another OpenClaw-like agent
description: The new features would be geared toward enterprise customers, with better security controls than the famously risky open source OpenClaw agent.
author: Julie Bort

title: Stanford report highlights growing disconnect between AI insiders and everyone else
description: Stanford’s latest AI Index shows a widening gap between experts and the public, with rising anxiety over jobs, healthcare, and the economy.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch signals IPO readiness as AI agents fuel revenue surge
description: "The company is ready and getting more ready for every day," Rauch said about an IPO at the HumanX conference.
author: Marina Temkin

title: The largest orbital compute cluster is open for business
description: Kepler Communications is flying 40 GPUs in Earth orbit. And its latest customer is Sophia Space.
author: Tim Fernholz

title: Trump officials may be encouraging banks to test Anthropic’s Mythos model
description: The report is particularly surprising since the Department of Defense recently declared Anthropic a supply-chain risk.
author: Anthony Ha

title: Apple reportedly testing four designs for upcoming smart glasses
description: These glasses are a step back from an ambitious plan that once called for Apple to launch a variety of mixed and augmented reality devices.
author: Anthony Ha

title: From LLMs to hallucinations, here’s a simple guide to common AI terms
description: The rise of AI has brought an avalanche of new terms and slang. Here is a glossary with definitions of some of the most important words and phrases you might encounter.
author: Natasha Lomas, Romain Dillet, Kyle Wiggers, Lucas Ropek

title: At the HumanX conference, everyone was talking about Claude
description: Anthropic was the star of the show at San Francisco's AI-centric conference.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Sam Altman responds to ‘incendiary’ New Yorker article after attack on his home
description: The OpenAI CEO's new blog post responds to both an apparent attack on his home and an in-depth New Yorker profile raising questions about his trustworthiness.
author: Anthony Ha

title: Anthropic temporarily banned OpenClaw’s creator from accessing Claude
description: This ban took place after Claude's pricing changed for OpenClaw users last week.
author: Julie Bort

title: Stalking victim sues OpenAI, claims ChatGPT fueled her abuser’s delusions and ignored her warnings
description: OpenAI ignored three warnings that a ChatGPT user was dangerous — including its own mass-casualty flag — while he stalked and harassed his ex-girlfriend, a new lawsuit alleges.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: TechCrunch is heading to Tokyo — and bringing the Startup Battlefield with it
description: SusHi Tech 2026 is zeroing in on four technology domains reshaping society: AI, Robotics, Resilience, and Entertainment. Expect live demos of humanoid robots, sessions on autonomous driving's software revolution, deep dives into cyber defense and climate tech, and candid conversations about how AI is rewriting the global music and anime industries.
author: Cindy Zackney

title: Last 24 hours: Save up to $500 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass
description: This is it. Tonight is your last chance to lock in savings of up to $500 for your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass. These discounts end at 11:59 p.m. PT.
author: TechCrunch Events
